name: Tousled, dead-set stare
note: Tufts mostly up, two tipping forward. Level glare, flat mouth. White tee, black shoes.

name: Pushed forward, side-eye
note: Front pushed forward and across. Eyes cut to the side, small smirk. Cream tee, white sneakers.

name: Choppy, one brow up
note: Low tufts every which way. One brow cocked, mouth pursed to the side. Pale blue tee, sling bag.

name: Forward sweep, on a mission
note: A bold sweep over the brow. Hard squint, lips pressed, leaning into his stride. Mint tee, black shoes.
